summary: Software engineer with a Master's in Computer Science and hands-on experience across backend APIs, device integration, data pipelines and applied ML work. Currently building Python services and hardware-abstraction layers for a smart-display platform at Northwind Devices.

bullets: Developed Python/Django APIs that let phones, remotes and smart-home hubs control 4 display product lines.
Integrated a new hardware abstraction layer into existing display OS components by refactoring legacy interfaces, removing a vendor library dependency across 3 chipsets.
Designed integration test interfaces for system-level validation using BDD with Behave and Python unit tests.
Diagnosed and resolved defects across multiple OS components to support QA and production releases.
Built an automated defect-tracking report that saves the team lead about 5 hours every week.
Consolidated four release branches into one stable branch, cutting cherry-pick overhead and fix divergence between releases.
Configured Linux servers and installed dependencies for the lab website, database and ML workloads.
Assessed team requirements and recommended hardware for better performance and cost-efficiency.
Contributed to an LLM assistant that drafts daily practice plans for music students from long-term goals.
Built a sports-history chatbot with LangChain, an open-weights 7B model and RAG retrieval over 20 years of match reports.
Evaluated four open models and reached 96% accuracy on a 300-question club-history benchmark.
Designed and developed a Flutter front end for a fan community website.
Wrote Python programs that analyze genome sequencing data to the lab's requirements under a principal investigator.
Contributed to a project measuring genetic diversity across five research colonies.
Implemented a pipeline that pre-processes live sensor feeds with Python, GraphQL and Redis, with CI/CD integration.
Optimized the pipeline to support predictive analytics and real-time risk monitoring.
Built a live risk dashboard with Grafana and React.
Reached 84% accuracy on mobile skin-condition screening with OpenCV, TensorFlow and CNNs.
Developed a noise-reduction step in Python that helps detect heart conditions from phone-recorded stethoscope audio.

projects.name: Document Question Answering with LLMs
projects.description: Built a RAG question-answering service over PDF, CSV and JSON files that answers 95% of a 200-question test set correctly.
bullets: Used LangChain for retrieval and storage, with prompt templates tuned per file type.
Benchmarked chat quality on diverse and complex queries before each release.

projects.name: Rooftop Antenna Counter
bullets: Built a multimodal LLM pipeline that combines street-level images and text to count rooftop antennas at given addresses.
Pulled multi-angle images from a street imagery API for each address.
Extended the LLM with LangChain tools for computer-vision tasks.

projects.name: Plant Disease Detector App
bullets: Led a 24-hour hackathon team building a plant-disease detector with TensorFlow Lite for on-device classification.
Preprocessed and augmented 9,000 public leaf images with OpenCV and tuned the model to 81% accuracy.
Shipped an Android app that classifies leaves from the camera and points to the nearest garden center.
